comment: Binds each combat action's phase timing to the GeckoLib clips that telegraph it.
Action tick counts are read from the Java sources and are not repeated here;
duplicating them would let the two drift silently, which is the bug this
A clip may cover several phases, or one clip may be authored per phase.
Every phase must be covered exactly once, or the action declared unbound.

unbound.reason: No player animation is authored yet. The action commits the player for 10 wind-up + 1 active + 16 recovery = 27 ticks (1.35s) with nothing shown on the player, which reads as input lag. Bind this once a player clip exists; PlayerAnimator (MIT) is the likely route.

Combat Core's generic player melee intentionally has no Shadow Slave animation. It re-times the vanilla swing and stays Shadow-Slave-agnostic by design, so binding it here would violate the Combat Core ownership boundary.
